terms.grammar: adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis)
terms.comment: The eighth month, counting from March. Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Octōbrēs: the 1st, 7th and 15th.

phrases.latin: cessent et Īdūs dormiant in Octōbrēs: aestāte puerī sī valent, satis discunt
phrases.english: let the canes rest and sleep till the Ides of October: in summer, if boys keep well, they learn enough

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 77, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
